Hello! I'm AURA, your AI-powered Medical Health Operating System. I'm here to assist clinicians and patients with health-related questions, symptom analysis, medication guidance, and clinical reasoning.

Please remember: I'm designed to support, not replace, qualified healthcare professionals. For any diagnosis, treatment decisions, or persistent health concerns, always consult a doctor or licensed medical provider.

How can I help you today? Whether you're experiencing symptoms, have questions about medications, need clarification on clinical information, or want evidence-based health guidance, I'm here to provide compassionate, precise support.
Are you experiencing sudden weakness or numbness on one side of your face or body?
Do you notice any swelling of your lips, tongue, face, or difficulty swallowing?
Does your chest pain or pressure radiate to your left arm, shoulder, neck, or jaw?
Does the chest pain get sharply worse when taking a deep breath in?
Does the chest pain get worse with physical exertion and feel relieved when resting?
Have you noticed painful swelling or redness in one of your calves or legs?
